summary: Full e2e validation of Marketing Studio Phase 2 (Reels en video) plus image-post regression. Backend: 9/9 pytest passing in 86s including 2 full FFmpeg renders (bundled music + sin música), 3 music endpoints, no-photos 400 Spanish validation, list+delete, image-post brand_color/accent_color regression, and the DELETE /api/card/logo route-shadowing fix. Frontend Playwright: login -> /marketing -> mode-reel -> upload 2 photos -> brief -> energetica music + preview -> orange theme -> generate -> reel-video + reel-download-btn rendered in ~18s with src pointing to /api/public/card/photo/{id} -> reel-history populated. Image-mode regression: all 3 templates (showcase, before_after, promo) + 11 color themes visible. UI 100% Spanish. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 5251 lines (was 4997 last iteration). Reels endpoints add ~200 more lines on top. Strongly recommend extracting social/reels into /app/backend/routes/social_reels.py and the helper _process_reel + ALLOWED_AUDIO_TYPES into video_service. Maintainability risk keeps growing.

POST /api/social/reels silently drops invalid photos via `skipped` counter but only surfaces the message when source_ids is empty. If user uploads 5 mixed files where 1 valid + 4 oversize/wrong-type, they get a 'success' processing reel with just 1 photo and no warning. Consider returning a warnings list in the response.

DELETE /api/social/reels/{id} hard-deletes the doc but only soft-deletes the video photo (is_deleted=true). Source photos uploaded for the reel (social_src) and any uploaded music (social_audio) are NEVER cleaned up. DB cruft grows per reel created. Same pattern as social posts noted previously.
_process_reel error path stores str(e)[:300] which may leak internal stack details into the API response. Consider mapping common ffmpeg/render failures to user-friendly Spanish messages.
Music preview in ReelStudio uses an inline <audio ref> with currentTime reset; no visible 'playing' indicator other than icon swap. Minor UX.
Frontend ReelStudio polls every 2.5s (typical) — fine for one user, but if a user opens multiple tabs polling is unthrottled. Negligible at current scale.

video_service.MUSIC_TRACKS is filtered by bundled_music_path() existence — good defensive code, but if a bundled track file is missing the GET /api/social/music endpoint silently returns fewer items. Add a startup check + log warning so ops notice missing assets.
seed_data_creation: Pytest creates 2 reels (energetica + no-music) and 1 image post — all cleaned up via DELETE at the end of the run. Any reels left behind by an earlier interrupted run were cleaned via a one-off DELETE pass after the Playwright run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_social_reels.py (pytest, self-cleaning). Each run consumes 3 LLM generations (2 reels + 1 image post) and triggers 2 FFmpeg renders (~12-20s each on this pod). Total wall time ~85-95s. Run with `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://all-in-one-web-15.preview.emergentagent.com && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_social_reels.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/reels_results.xml`. Endpoints verified: GET /api/social/music (3 tracks: energetica, corporativa, lofi with /api/social/music/{id} url), GET /api/social/music/{id} (audio bytes, 404 on unknown), POST /api/social/reels (multipart files+brief+language+music+accent_color -> status processing then ready with video.url -> /api/public/card/photo/{id} serves video/mp4 non-empty; no-photos -> 400 Spanish; music=none -> ready reel), GET /api/social/reels list, DELETE /api/social/reels/{id} -> {ok:true}, 2nd delete -> 404. Regression confirmed: POST /api/social/posts with brand_color #171717 + accent_color #f59e0b persists both colors; DELETE /api/card/logo no longer shadowed by /card/{card_id} (returns 200/204, never 'Tarjeta no encontrada'). Frontend selectors all match spec: mode-image, mode-reel, reel-studio, reel-add-photo (multi-file input), reel-brief-input, reel-music-{none|energetica|corporativa|lofi|upload}, reel-music-preview-{id}, reel-color-{orange|verde|azul|...} (11 themes incl. custom), reel-generate-btn, reel-video, reel-download-btn, reel-history, reel-history-{id}, reel-history-delete-{id}.
